notes.title: MIRAI #167 is in Tiny Teams!

[/p][p][/p][p]It's a real honor to be included in such an important festival and we would like to thank all the team at 'Yogscast Games' for making this possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Take a look into all the selected (and great!) indie games here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url].
